symptom: Two deployments of the saved v790 Sites version failed during building with Cloudflare Sandbox build stream request failed and never reached provider publishing or activation.
expected_behavior: The cumulative VII candidate should build inside the managed Sites pipeline with enough resource margin to reach publishing and activation.
environment: VII Sites production project appgprj_6a71ccdca27481918bf04dd329d3eb21, Business workspace, saved v790 version appgprj_6a71ccdca27481918bf04dd329d3eb21~appgver_45f2497c6f4081919d7f05ae79f37639, environment revision 31, investigated 2026-11-04 Asia/Jerusalem.

steps: Inspect the two terminal failed v790 deployment records.
Build the frozen candidate locally with the same project build command.
Measure the complete dist output after the existing duplicate-media pruning.
reproduction.evidence: Both managed attempts failed at building with provider_deployment_id, URL and archive storage unset. The local v790 output contained 1,933 files and 253.67 MiB after existing pruning.

observations.observation: No normal account usage or credit limit is active.
observations.evidence: The authenticated Business account showed 100 percent of the five-hour and weekly limits remaining and 5,121 workspace credits.

observations.observation: The project is active and its configuration was not suspended or missing.
observations.evidence: Sites settings showed an active PUBLIC project, connected database, unchanged environment revision 31 and disabled_by null.

observations.observation: The failed deployments never entered provider publishing.
observations.evidence: Both records reached failed from building with provider_deployment_id null, URL null and archive_storage null.

observations.observation: The candidate artifact was within about 2.33 MiB of the known 256 MiB extracted deployment ceiling.
observations.evidence: The final local dist measured 253.67 MiB. Earlier project deployments had returned explicit extracted-size failures at the same 256 MiB boundary.

observations.observation: Most of the risk came from unused verified-media copies.
observations.evidence: A runtime reachability inventory found 736 files under dist/client/media/verified with no explicit reference in app, worker or build sources, totaling 94.66 MiB.

observations.observation: Removing only unreachable output copies restores substantial deployment margin.
observations.evidence: Three clean production builds completed at 159.00 MiB while every explicit verified-media reference resolved and all source media remained unchanged.

hypotheses.mechanism: The Business account is blocked by usage, credit, plan or project suspension limits.
hypotheses.prediction: The account or project settings would expose an exhausted quota, disabled project or missing required configuration.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect authenticated account usage and the VII Sites project settings.
hypotheses.result: Usage limits were fully available, credits remained, the project was active and required configuration was present.

hypotheses.mechanism: A broad OpenAI Sites or Cloudflare outage is preventing all deployments.
hypotheses.prediction: Official provider status would report an active relevant incident.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect current official OpenAI and Cloudflare status pages.
hypotheses.result: No broad relevant incident was reported during the failure window.

hypotheses.mechanism: The application cannot compile or its release baseline is broken.
hypotheses.prediction: The frozen source would fail the local production build or release baseline.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Run the production build and the release baseline locally.
hypotheses.result: The application compiled and the 23-test release baseline passed.

hypotheses.mechanism: The deployment artifact is so close to the managed 256 MiB extraction ceiling that sandbox packaging or streaming fails before provider publication.
hypotheses.prediction: The frozen output will be nearly 256 MiB, unused static media will dominate the excess, and deterministic removal of unreachable copies will restore large margin without breaking references.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Measure the frozen output, inventory static-media reachability, add fail-closed pruning and rebuild repeatedly.
hypotheses.result: The output was 253.67 MiB. Exactly 736 unreachable verified-media copies totaled 94.66 MiB. The repaired build completed repeatedly at 159.00 MiB with all explicit references intact.

fix.change: At the deployment artifact boundary, remove only verified-media output files with no explicit runtime reference, retain every alias target, reject dynamic verified-media construction, verify every reference resolves and fail the build above a 220 MiB output budget.
fix.evidence: The final build removed 94.66 MiB across 736 unreachable files, retained referenced and alias-target media, finished at 159.00 MiB and passed the four negative and positive artifact tests plus the 23-test release baseline.

regression_checks.evidence: The positive fixture kept the referenced file and every real candidate reference resolved after the full build.
The negative fixture failed closed with Referenced verified media is missing after pruning.

regression_checks.check: Dynamic verified-media construction blocks unsafe pruning
regression_checks.evidence: The dynamic-path fixture failed closed before deleting unknown assets.
The budget fixture failed closed above its configured limit and the real output passed at 159.00 MiB against 220 MiB.

regression_checks.check: Existing VII release baseline remains intact

remaining_unknowns: The managed service does not expose its internal sandbox termination reason, so the exact provider exception remains unavailable.
A real managed deployment of the repaired candidate still requires explicit publication authorization and is the final proof of provider acceptance.
authorization_boundary: Account and project inspection, local code repair and candidate verification were authorized. No new public Version or Deployment was created in this task.
